channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Entidades brasileiras pedem investigação da Meta ao Congresso dos EUA
item.description: The Vladimir Herzog Institute and CTRL+Z have requested the U.S. Congress to investigate suspected favoritism by Meta toward Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy in the 2026 elections, alleging undue influence by major digital platforms in the Brazilian electoral process.

item.title: MPE diz que Meta descumpriu parte de decisões do TSE e vê falta de isonomia
item.description: The Electoral Public Ministry states that Meta failed to comply with part of the TSE's decisions regarding content treatment during the presidential election runoff. The ministry also points to unequal use of the company's platforms.

item.title: Richarlison mostra documentos após cobrança de Willer Tomaz
item.description: Richarlison shared legal documents on Instagram to verify his purchase of a property in Ilha Comprida, responding to lawyer Willer Tomaz, who pledged to transfer the property rights if valid proof was shown. The dispute involves Sport 70, a partner company of the player, and Tomaz's WT Administração, which claims to have acquired the rights through an agreement with M Locadora. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro was mentioned as a witness but denied any involvement with the property. In 2025, the Superior Court of Justice upheld a ruling favorable to WT, and Sport 70's lawsuit was dismissed without ruling on the merits.

item.title: Câmara e Senado fazem cobertura integrada do segundo turno das eleições
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies and the Senate conduct integrated coverage of the 2026 election runoff with live broadcasts starting at 2 PM on the Chamber's Portal. Over 30 legislative TV and radio stations participate, providing analysis, interviews and political context with experts and electoral authorities. The production highlights active social participation through the Legislative Power.

item.title: Crusoé: Pesquisa Indexa reforça estabilidade entre Flávio e Lula
item.description: Indexa poll shows technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT), with 45.2% and 44.1% voting intentions, respectively. Whites and nulls total 4.3%, undecided 1.6%, and 4.8% of interviewees said they will not vote.

item.title: O que apontam os trackings de Lula e Flávio a poucos dias da eleição
item.description: A few days before the 2026 presidential runoff, internal campaign trackings for Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) show diverging trends. While Lula's internal polls indicate a technical tie at 50% each, the main PL tracking shows a three-point lead for Flávio. Official published polls also confirm a technical tie, though most show a slight lead for the PL candidate.

item.title: PV fecha questão por reeleição de Hugo Motta à presidência da Câmara
item.description: The Green Party (PV) caucus decided to support Hugo Motta's (Republicanos-PB) re-election as President of the Chamber of Deputies during a meeting held on Wednesday, the 21st. The gathering also included the induction of four new lawmakers and reaffirmed the party’s backing for President Lula’s re-election ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Famosos declaram apoio a Lula e Flávio, mas não votam
item.description: Celebrities who publicly supported Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro did not vote in the first round, with some justifying their absence and others having canceled voter registration. Singer Anitta and presenter Fábio Porchat had their absence justification approved, while Luana Piovani, Matuê, and Cellbit appear with canceled registration. Some used their platforms to mobilize political support via social media and coordinated campaigns.

item.title: Pedras votando em britadeiras (por Felipe Sampaio)
item.description: The text reflects on the 2026 Brazilian election, highlighting support for candidates who, according to the author, harmed the country in the past, amid a more conservative political and social scenario. The analysis points to a growing defense of punitive policies, such as the death penalty, and the relevance of decisions based on government performance, criticizing electoral amnesia.

item.title: Equipe de Flávio prevê economia de R$ 450 bi ao enxugar servidores públicos com IA
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's economic team coordinator, Daniella Marques, stated that his government could save R$450 billion by replacing 12 million public servants with artificial intelligence. The remarks, made in August, went viral after being published by Folha de S.Paulo. Marques also expects a R$150 billion reduction in spending on outsourced personnel and technology.

item.title: Que horas será o debate presidencial da Globo nesta sexta? Veja como assistir
item.description: The TV Globo presidential debate between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT) will take place on Friday (23) at 9:20 PM, following the nightly news. The debate will be broadcast live across the network’s platforms, including free-to-air TV, the g1 website, GloboNews, and Globoplay.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE julga pedido de resposta contra Lula por uso de foto
item.description: The Brazilian Electoral Court (TSE) will rule on Thursday (Oct 22, 2026) on the right of response filed by Val Meliga against Lula and the 'Brazil Ready for More' coalition for unauthorized use of her image in electoral advertising. The PT campaign, titled 'Which Brazil Do You Want?', aired a statement calling Val Meliga and her group 'criminals and corrupt', prompting the honor offense claim.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Rio terá transporte público gratuito no 2º turno
item.description: Rio de Janeiro provides free public transport for the 2026 election runoff on Sunday, covering buses, BRT, VLT and vans from morning to evening. The measure, set by TSE and TRE-RJ resolutions, aims to facilitate voters' access to polling stations.

item.title: Equipe de Lula diz que PMs mandaram presos vestirem camisas do PT
item.description: PT filed a lawsuit with the Electoral Prosecutor's Office to investigate the São Paulo Military Police after a video showed detainees wearing pro-Lula shirts, alleging that officers forced them to wear the shirts to spread electoral misinformation. The mother of a teenage detainee reported physical abuse and police entering her home. The incident occurred in Piracicaba during a drug trafficking operation.

item.title: Transporte público do DF no 2º turno será gratuito e terá frota de dia útil
item.description: Public transportation in the Federal District will be free and operate on a weekday schedule on Sunday (October 25th) during the second round of the 2026 elections, as established by Article 23 of TSE Resolution No. 23,751/2026. The measure exempts lines serving the Esplanada dos Ministérios, SIA, and Saan, maintaining Sunday schedules. The operation includes fleet reinforcement and real-time monitoring.

item.title: Economist questiona se Lula, 'agora azarão', ainda tem 'uma última carta na manga'
item.description: The Economist questions whether Lula, after losing the first round, still has 'one last trick up his sleeve' for the second round. The magazine considers the 2026 election race the fiercest since Brazil's democratization.

item.title: Flávio corre risco ao dar controle da campanha para Marçal, que debocha de eleitor de Renan Santos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro risks his campaign by handing strategic control to Pablo Marçal, whose clash with Renan Santos voters could alienate key votes. The alliance aims to counter left-wing dominance on social media, but aggressive rhetoric and disrespectful remarks threaten the margin needed to win.

item.title: Confira a agenda dos presidenciáveis nesta quinta-feira (22)
item.description: With three days left before the runoff, Lula da Silva (PT) spends the day recording campaign ads, while Flávio Bolsonro (PL) has no public schedule and hosts a YouTube live at 7 PM. The order of candidate agenda announcements follows a daily rotation.

item.title: Abstenção pode decidir disputa, mas Flávio segue favorito, diz CEO da Indexa
item.description: The 2026 Indexa/Broadcast poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 45.2% of voting intentions, ahead of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva at 44.1%. According to Indexa’s CEO Arilton Freres, Lula relies more on abstaining voters, which keeps Flávio as the favorite, though the race remains open.

item.title: Indexa/Broadcast: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 45,2% ante 44,1% de Lula no 2º turno, em empate técnico
item.description: The Indexa/Broadcast poll shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (45.2%) and Lula (44.1%) in the second round, within a 2.2-point margin. Flávio leads among Evangelicals and in the South, while Lula leads among Catholics and in the Northeast.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro formalizam abertura de sigilos no TSE a três dias do segundo turno
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro will formalize the opening of bank, tax, and phone secrecy files at the TSE on Thursday, three days before the runoff. The move follows demands for transparency, though full data analysis is unlikely to finish before voting.

item.title: A diferença entre a última pesquisa Datafolha sobre Flávio x Lula antes do primeiro turno e o resultado das urnas
item.description: The last Datafolha poll released on October 3 showed Lula ahead of Flávio Bolsonaro by 3 percentage points, but the election results the next day revealed Flávio leading with 47.03% of valid votes against Lula's 45.16%. The main difference came from Flávio's performance, who scored 5.03 percentage points more than the survey indicated, while Lula ended up just 0.16 point above the projection. Despite the inversion, the poll already showed a technical tie between the two candidates when considering the margin of error.

item.title: Investigados por lavagem com bets, Willer e Flávio dividem endereços, voos e parceiros comerciais
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, and attorney Willer Tomaz are under Federal Police investigation for money laundering linked to bets, sharing addresses, flights, and business partners, according to Folha documents.

item.title: Lulinha, Luchsinger e Lava Jato: o que realmente pesa contra Lula?
item.description: In the first debate of the 2026 presidential runoff, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro exchanged corruption accusations involving family members and lobbyists. Lula challenged Flávio to open financial and phone records of both candidates and their families, while facing scrutiny over recent cases such as former banker Daniel Vorcaro. Despite having his convictions annulled by the Supreme Court, Lula remains under pressure due to his association with past Lava Jato investigations.

item.title: STF mantém lei paulista que sujeita policial penal a trabalhar em condições precárias de segurança
item.description: The STF upheld the constitutionality of State Law Complement 1.416/2024, which regulates the career of the São Paulo Prison Police, rejecting the Direct Action of Unconstitutionality 7781 filed by Agepen Brasil. The justices approved the subordination of the force to the Penitentiary Administration Secretariat and maintained provisions allowing service under risky conditions and restrictions on public statements by police officers. Justice Luiz Fux was the only one to vote partly against, advocating the removal of the phrase 'precarious conditions' from the statute.

item.title: Agenda dos candidatos: Lula grava propaganda em Brasília; Flávio Bolsonaro realiza live
item.description: Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) are in Brasília with no public events scheduled. Lula records campaign materials, while Flávio hosts an online livestream. Both avoid in-person interactions with voters.

item.title: Pesquisa PoderData mostra empate técnico entre Flávio e Lula a 3 dias do 2º turno
item.description: A PoderData poll released three days before the 2026 presidential runoff shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), with 51% and 49% of valid votes respectively, within the 1.6-point margin of error. Compared to the previous survey, Flávio dipped from 52% to 51%, while Lula rose from 48% to 49%.

item.title: Por qué Milei necesita enemigos más allá de la Argentina
item.description: President Javier Milei uses diplomatic conflicts, such as the expulsion of a Brazilian journalist and disputes in Spain, as tools for internal political construction. While these actions may seem illogical from an external perspective, they serve strategically to reinforce his base and position himself as a defender of libertarian ideas.

item.title: La Amazonia en la encrucijada: el voto de los brasileños decide el futuro de la selva
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian elections place the Amazon at risk, with two opposing development models in dispute — one focused on preservation and the other on economic exploitation —, though the issue has been largely absent from the campaign. Brazilians vote not only to choose the president but also for the fate of the world's largest tropical rainforest and the indigenous and traditional communities dependent on it.

item.title: PM-SP acusa campanha de Lula e governo de ameaça e descumprimento de ordem judicial na Paulista
item.description: São Paulo Military Police accuses Lula's campaign and federal agencies of blocking Avenida Paulista and Rua Augusta, violating a TRE decision. The report highlights obstruction the day before the first round of elections.

item.title: Kassio repete padrão de Moraes em 2022 ao acolher pedidos de retirada de propaganda de Lula e Flávio
item.description: Kassio Nunes Marques granted 44.4% of requests to remove election ads, mirroring Alexandre de Moraes' pattern in 2022. Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign had a higher approval rate (71.4%) compared to Lula's (27.3%).

item.title: TSE demora mais a decidir ações de Lula contra Flávio; Kassio concentra casos do petista no 2º turno
item.description: The TSE, under Kassio Nunes Marques' presidency, has been slower to rule on actions filed by Lula's campaign against Flávio Bolsonaro, while cases initiated by Flávio are resolved more quickly. Data shows Kassio is handling nearly half of Lula's cases and is among the slowest ministers, prompting criticism from Lula's allies and legal experts.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro já defendeu proposta mais rígida sobre maioridade penal
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) has advocated since 2015 for lowering the criminal majority age from 18 to 16 and eliminating minimum age requirements for juvenile criminal responsibility, a stricter stance than his current campaign messaging aimed at undecided voters. His proposal is supported by 80% of Brazilians, including 70% of Lula voters and 89% of Bolsonaro supporters. The statements were made during a public hearing at Alerj and later as chair of the Senate Public Security Committee.

item.title: CNBB defende Constituição e pede intercessão de Nossa Senhora após embate com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The CNBB issued a message to the Brazilian people emphasizing environmental and human rights protection and requesting the intercession of Our Lady of Aparecida, following a debate with senator Flávio Bolsonaro. The statement reflects the Church’s concerns on social and environmental issues.

item.title: Instagram amplia visualizações de políticos mesmo com freio do TSE, diz estudo
item.description: Study shows Instagram continues to amplify politician views despite TSE restrictions on profile recommendations. Rules were implemented to reduce candidate influence on social media during elections, but reach remains significant. Research suggests algorithms bypass restrictions, maintaining politician visibility.

item.title: Eleição tem 1,8 milhão de votos em candidatos com registro indeferido e recurso pendente no TSE
item.description: Voters cast 1.8 million votes for candidates whose registration was denied by regional electoral courts but who remained on ballots while appeals were pending at the Supreme Electoral Court. The situation highlights gaps in electoral oversight and may face post-election challenges. The case is under review at Brazil's top electoral tribunal.

item.title: Eleições 2026: como encontrar meu título de eleitor?
item.description: Voters can check their voter ID number, registration status, and polling location online via the TSE's Autoatendimento Eleitoral (Título Net) or the e-Título app, free of charge and without physical presence. The service requires only basic personal data such as full name, CPF, and date of birth.

item.title: Qual o futuro dos concursos públicos? Veja o que propõem Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro do not set specific targets for federal public competitions in the next term, but their government plans suggest different approaches to public administration. The g1 analyzed the history of hires and the official documents of both candidates, concluding that available data does not allow predicting how many competitions will be opened in the coming years.

item.title: PF encontra sala secreta para guardar dinheiro em hangar usado por amigo de Flávio Bolsonaro, diz jornal
item.description: Federal Police found a secret room in a hangar at Brasília International Airport, used by aviation companies of lawyer Willer Tomaz, friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, to store cash and a bill-counting machine.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede cassação da candidatura de Flávio Bolsonaro por "interferência" da Meta
item.description: Lula's campaign requested the election court to annul Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy due to alleged interference by Meta before the runoff. The accusation seeks to disqualify the opponent for electoral irregularities.

item.title: Ciro Nogueira quer ser ministro de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Ciro Nogueira (PP), defeated in the Senate race, aims to become a minister under Flávio Bolsonaro if he wins the 2026 elections. His vice-presidential bid was jeopardized by a PF investigation linked to former banker Daniel Vorcaro. Despite this, his federation endorsed Flávio in the second round.

item.title: Milei hace política exterior a golpe de insultos: choques con Sánchez, Lula, Petro y Arce
item.description: Javier Milei uses insults as a foreign policy strategy, sparking criticism and diplomatic crises with progressive leaders like Sánchez, Lula, Petro, and Arce. His aggressive rhetoric, common in Argentina, spreads internationally, straining diplomatic relations.

item.title: Em busca dos alienados
item.description: The 2026 presidential election concludes with an unprecedented scenario: the winner must convince those who did not vote in the first round, especially to vote for him rather than the opponent. Lula needs to surpass Flávio Bolsonaro in the final stretch, according to the latest Vox Populi poll, which shows improved perception of his government.

item.title: Em novo programa, Lula mira indecisos e critica oposição
item.description: Lula’s campaign criticizes the Bolsonaro government and presents economic and social proposals to attract undecided voters, such as tax cuts on basic goods and protection for the Farmácia Popular program. The ads also touch on public security and firearms, using a symbolic scene about rising gun ownership and family risks.

item.title: Lula x Flávio Bolsonaro: o que diz a pesquisa Quaest sobre o 2º turno - O Assunto #1830
item.description: The Quaest poll for the runoff shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), at 45%, and Lula (PT), at 44%. The percentage of undecided voters doubled to 14%, with high rejection rates: 52% for Flávio and 47% for Lula. The rise in undecided voters and electoral alienation may determine the outcome of Sunday’s (25th) election.

item.title: Lula e Flávio prometem tudo, como se dinheiro brotasse do nada
item.description: In the final stretch, Lula and Flávio expand economic pledges without detailing funding sources, worsening fiscal challenges. Neither candidate explains how to fulfill promises within an already strained budget. The race for votes may heighten criticism over the feasibility of their proposals.

item.title: Lula diz que PF apura perda de ilha de Richarlison para amigo de Flávio
item.description: President Lula called for an investigation into the loss of Richarlison's $10 million mansion, which transferred from the footballer to lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, amid allegations of judicial irregularities.

item.title: TSE come poeira dos algoritmos
item.description: The 2026 electoral race is facing criticism over alleged algorithm interference from big tech companies, particularly Meta, in the Brazilian electoral process. The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) is investigating suspicions of manipulation by foreign platforms, raising concerns about the integrity of the election.

item.title: Presidente da República: o que faz, quanto ganha e quais são os requisitos para ocupar o cargo?
item.description: The President of the Republic is the head of the federal Executive Branch, elected for a four-year term with the possibility of re-election, and serves as both head of state and head of government. Among their duties are coordinating national policies, appointing ministers, and setting the government agenda. The 2026 election runoff was contested between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Datafolha divulga nova pesquisa presidencial nesta quinta-feira (22)
item.description: Datafolha releases the penultimate 2026 presidential poll, showing a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Lula (PT). Commissioned by Globo and Folha, the survey interviewed 2,154 people from October 20-22, with a ±2% margin of error and 95% confidence.
